ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, filled button background, nav logo — the only dark surface in the system; every CTA and body headline resolves to this near-black

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, button text, elevated card surfaces — the dominant background tone carrying ~76 frequency points

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Card surfaces, secondary backgrounds, input fills — the quiet layer beneath paper for nested content

fog-white.$description: Fog White — Secondary page background for alternating sections, hover surfaces — one step above paper for subtle band variation

slate-gray.$description: Slate Gray — Link color, muted helper text, footer copy — cool desaturated gray that sits between body text and disabled

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Tertiary labels, category tags (Marketing, Finance, Sales) — one step lighter than link color

smoke-gray.$description: Smoke Gray — Placeholder text (Ask anything…), disabled labels — the lightest functional gray, used when text recedes

blush-peach.$description: Blush Peach — Accent card background, warm highlight wash — the only chromatic surface in the system; creates editorial warmth against monochrome

sienna-brown.$description: Sienna Brown — Text and stroke on peach surfaces, dark accent for chart line strokes — a warm deep brown that pairs with Blush Peach like ink on kraft paper

signifier.$description: Display and headline serif — used exclusively for H1/H2 at three sizes; weight stays at 400 (regular) at every scale, which is the signature choice: the serif whispers authority rather than shouting in bold

sohne.$description: Body, UI, and navigation sans — the workhorse covering everything from 14px metadata to 26px subheads; the half-step weights (430, 450, 480) create fine-grained hierarchy without jumping to bold
